rule YARA_CobaltStrike_Generic_Fixed {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beacons with reduced false positives"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1071.001, T1218.011"

        uint32(0) == 0x00904550 and
        pe.imphash() != "d7a9e8e9c3f1b4e5a8c2d6e7f1a2b3c4" and
        not (hash.sha256(0, filesize) == "a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2")

arguments.summary: Post-exploitation activity detected originating from host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.14). A phishing email triggered execution of encoded PowerShell within Outlook, leading to the download and execution of a malicious DLL via rundll32.exe. The payload established C2 communication with a known-bad IP (198.51.100.23) over HTTPS, indicative of Cobalt Strike beaconing. Lateral movement was observed via SMB to internal systems, including a file server. Credential access attempts and host file modifications were detected. The user CORP\jsmith's credentials and MFA token were reset. A full endpoint scan detected a secondary Linux threat on a different system, unrelated to this incident. Initial sandbox analysis failed to capture full behavioral scope due to limited emulation depth.

timeline.description: Nmap scan from external IP 192.168.1.100 to internal host WS-IT-101 (10.0.2.15) detected and blocked.
User CORP\jsmith launched Outlook (outlook.exe) on WS-FIN-042.
Encoded PowerShell command executed as child of Outlook, indicative of phishing payload (T1566.001).
rundll32.exe loaded unsigned DLL from Temp directory (beacon.dll), establishing C2 beacon to 198.51.100.23:443 (T1218.011, T1071.001).
IDS alert triggered: 'ET TROJAN Cobalt Strike Beacon C2' confirmed malicious traffic.
Failed Kerberos TGT request from WS-FIN-042 to DC, suggesting credential brute-force or spraying attempt (T1528).
Successful SMB access from WS-FIN-042 to file server 10.0.5.50, confirming lateral movement (T1021.002).
Post-exploitation alert generated based on EDR and SIEM correlation.
User CORP\jsmith password and MFA token reset via IAM system.
Full EPP scan initiated on WS-FIN-042; no threats found on Windows host.

arguments.summary: A post-exploitation alert was triggered from host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), attributed to user CORP\jsmith. Investigation revealed a malicious PowerShell execution chain originating from Outlook, leading to the execution of a Cobalt Strike beacon (detected via network signature). The sample hash e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0 was associated with the payload. Despite EDR identifying encoded PowerShell and suspicious rundll32 execution, the sandbox analysis returned a false negative due to limited behavioral coverage, omitting critical post-exploitation activities such as credential dumping, lateral movement, and persistence. The SIEM correlation confirmed multiple failed Kerberos attempts and successful SMB access, indicating active lateral movement. Immediate actions included password and MFA reset for the compromised user and a full endpoint scan that detected a secondary Linux dropper. No firewall isolation was approved during the admin phase, increasing exposure window.

timeline.description: Legitimate Outlook process started on WS-FIN-042 (PID 4812)
Suspicious encoded PowerShell launched from Outlook (T1566.001)
rundll32.exe executed unsigned beacon.dll from Temp directory (T1218.011)
IDS alert: Cobalt Strike beacon C2 traffic to 198.51.100.23 (T1071.001)
Failed Kerberos TGT request from WS-FIN-042 (indicative of password spraying or AS-REP roasting)
Successful SMB access to file server 10.0.3.10 (T1021.002 - Lateral Movement)
Post-exploitation activity alert triggered (INC-AP2-V5)
User jsmith password and MFA token reset
Full EPP scan completed; detected Dropper.Linux.Agent.F on WS-FIN-042

arguments.rule_content:
title: Suspicious PowerShell Launched from Office Application
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\\outlook.exe'
    Image|endswith: '\\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: '-enc', '-encodedcommand'
  condition: selection
level: high
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1566/001/
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate administrative scripts (rare)
author: SOC Team

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dynamic_Loader
{
    meta:
        description = "Detects runtime injection of Cobalt Strike beacons via rundll32 or similar loaders"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE T1218.011, T1055"
        date = "2026-04-09"

    strings:
        $x64_stub = { FF 15 ?? ?? ?? ?? 48 8D 0D ?? ?? ?? ?? E8 ?? ?? ?? ?? 84 C0 74 3C } // Common x64 reflective loader stub
        $config_marker = "windows/beacon" wide ascii

    condition:
        $x64_stub and $config_marker
}
